{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float after cleaning
revenue_clean = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
revenue_clean = pd.to_numeric(revenue_clean, errors='coerce')

# Check for any invalid conversions
invalid_revenue = revenue_clean.isna().sum()
print(f"Number of invalid revenue values after conversion: {invalid_revenue}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Drop refunded orders for revenue calculation
df_clean = df[~(df['status'] == 'refunded')]

# Convert revenue to float for the clean dataset
revenue_clean = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
revenue_clean = pd.to_numeric(revenue_clean, errors='coerce')

# Recalculate revenue after dropping refunded orders
df_clean = df_clean.copy()
df_clean['revenue'] = revenue_clean

# Group by channel and sum revenue
channel_revenue = df_clean.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()
print("Channel-wise revenue:")
print(channel_revenue)

# Find the channel with the highest revenue
max_revenue_channel = channel_revenue.loc[channel_revenue['revenue'].idxmax()]['channel']
max_revenue_value = channel_revenue['revenue'].max()

print(f"\nChannel with highest revenue: {max_revenue_channel} with ${max_revenue_value:,.2f}")"}
